plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco WAAS / WAVE WAN optimization appliances. It reports TFO load, optimized and pass-through connections, peers, DRE cache health, appliance alarms, CPU, memory, and interface traffic.
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: Uptime of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance since the last restart. Watching this value helps operators spot unexpected reboots and judge device stability.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Five-minute CPU utilization of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high usage can slow optimization and management response.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_1min
metrics.description: One-minute CPU utilization of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance as a 0-100 percentage. Use this when a shorter window than the five-minute average is needed.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Memory currently in use on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance, reported in the Cisco kilobyte convention and shown in bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance, reported in the Cisco kilobyte convention and shown in bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance as used divided by used plus free. Sustained high usage can degrade acceleration and cache handling.

metrics.name: tfo_load_ok
metrics.description: Normalized TFO load health of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Green maps to 1 (healthy); unknown, yellow, and red map to 2 (not healthy).

metrics.name: tfo_load_status
metrics.description: TFO load state of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Values are unknown (1), green (2), yellow (3), and red (4). Yellow or red means the optimizer is under pressure and new connections may be delayed or passed through.

metrics.name: tfo_active_opt_conn
metrics.description: Number of TCP connections currently being optimized by TFO on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. A drop to zero while traffic is expected usually means acceleration has stopped.

metrics.name: tfo_pending_conn
metrics.description: Number of connections waiting for TFO optimization on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. A sustained rise often appears together with yellow or red TFO load.

metrics.name: tfo_active_pt_conn
metrics.description: Number of connections currently passing through the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance without TFO optimization. A sudden jump can mean overload, policy bypass, or a peer problem.

metrics.name: active_peers
metrics.description: Number of currently active WAN optimization peers on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Zero while peers are expected means the far-end accelerator is down or unreachable.

metrics.name: max_active_peers
metrics.description: Configured upper limit of concurrent active peers on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Compare with the current active peer count to see remaining headroom.

metrics.name: dre_cache_ok
metrics.description: Normalized DRE cache health of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Usable maps to 1 (healthy); not usable, initializing, temporarily failed, and failed map to 2 (not healthy).

metrics.name: dre_cache_status
metrics.description: DRE cache state of the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Values are not usable (1), initializing (2), usable (3), temporarily failed (4), and failed (5). Anything other than usable means data reduction is impaired.

metrics.name: dre_cache_used_percent
metrics.description: Percentage of allocated DRE cache currently in use on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. High occupancy with a healthy cache is normal; occupancy stuck while the cache is not usable needs investigation.

metrics.name: dre_cache_total_mb
metrics.description: Total DRE cache capacity allocated on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance, in megabytes.

metrics.name: alarm_critical
metrics.description: Number of critical alarms currently raised on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Any non-zero value needs immediate attention.

metrics.name: alarm_major
metrics.description: Number of major alarms currently raised on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. A non-zero value should be investigated before it escalates.

metrics.name: alarm_minor
metrics.description: Number of minor alarms currently raised on the Cisco WAAS / WAVE appliance. Use this as an early warning alongside critical and major counts.
